fichas.title: Visual Perception: The Eye
fichas.summary: Explains how still and scanning images affect architectural perception, including field of view, detailed vision, perceived ceiling height, optical illusions, and the sizing and placement of details. It connects visual perception with spatial proportion, readability, street widths, and architectural rhythm.
uses: Relate ceiling height and wall spacing to perceived security, openness, and proportion
Estimate visual fields and viewing distances
Determine the legibility and apparent size of details
Plan street widths for overview and observation of detail
Position or shape building elements for visibility
